While this may be intentional photographic depth-of-field, the edges of the fingers show slight 'smearing' typical of AI generation when rendering complex organic shapes in motion/blur. However, it is not structurally catastrophic.

The texture of the pan bottom has a slightly uniform, noisy pattern that lacks the fine micro-scratches expected in real used metal pans. It looks slightly 'painted on' rather than physically worn, but this is subtle.
